main.description: One recovery bundle by vdeviceId. Mailbox endpoint: the caller is a chat device of the mailbox owner; every call reads or writes the caller DID's own mailbox. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded. Reading a bundle also records it as used (touchVirtualDevices).

lastUsedAt.description: When the bundle was last touched (server time).

expiresAt.description: When an unused keychain or passkey bundle will be deleted; absent for code and otc bundles.
